description: Update the coordinator so it drives the enclave by sourceId (+ optional request body for the POST call) instead of threading response bytes and a tlsProof. Covers spec task 7. Independent of the enclave Java module at compile time (separate Maven build) but contract-coupled to FEAT-002's new enclave request shape; order it after the enclave features so the wire contract is settled.
steps: In coordinator/src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/coordinator/Coordinator.java: remove the SOURCE and ENDPOINT constants. Change challengeBody(String requestId) to build {requestId, sourceId, policyVersion:"v1.0"} (add a sourceId parameter: challengeBody(String requestId, String sourceId)). Change enclaveRequest(...) signature to (String requestId, Map<String,Object> challenge, String sourceId, Object requestBody, String evidenceId, String eifDigest) and build the map {requestId, nonce, policyVersion, evidenceId, eifDigest, sourceId} plus requestBody only when requestBody != null. REMOVE rawPayload/rawResponseB64/tlsProof. Change run(...) signature to (String oleaUrl, int enclaveCid, int enclavePort, String sourceId, Object requestBody, Path dowsurePrivateKeyFile, String eifDigest) and thread sourceId/requestBody through challengeBody + enclaveRequest. Keep submissionEnvelope + Signer path unchanged.

In coordinator/src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/coordinator/CoordinatorMain.java: remove --raw-payload-file, --raw-response-b64-file, --tls-proof-file from parsing and the KNOWN set; add --source-id (required) and --request-body-file (optional; when present, read+parse its JSON into the requestBody object, else null). Update the USAGE string to the new surface (--olea-url, --source-id, [--request-body-file], --dowsure-private-key-file, --eif-digest, [--enclave-cid], [--enclave-port]). Call the new coordinator.run(...) arity.

In coordinator/src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/coordinator/VsockEnclaveClient.java: confirm it still serializes the request map generically (it uses mapper.writeValueAsBytes(request)); only touch it if a signature or field it reads changed. Do NOT invent changes.

Update coordinator/src/test/java/com/olea/dowsure/coordinator/CoordinatorTest.java: replace enclaveRequestPassesTlsProofThroughUntouched with a test asserting the enclave request carries sourceId and (for a POST case) requestBody and does NOT contain rawPayload/rawResponseB64/tlsProof. Update challengeBodyHasExactShape to the {requestId, sourceId, policyVersion} shape. Update runWiresChallengeEnclaveAndSignsEnvelope and runFailsClosedWhenEnclaveRejects to the new run(...) arity (pass a sourceId and null/obj requestBody instead of rawPayload/rawResponseB64/tlsProof). Keep the envelope-signature verification assertion.
acceptance_criteria: CoordinatorTest: the recorded enclave request map contains sourceId and omits rawPayload, rawResponseB64, and tlsProof; for the POST case it contains requestBody.
challengeBody produces exactly {requestId, sourceId, policyVersion} (3 keys).
run(...) compiles with the new arity and the submission signature still verifies over the canonical envelope with a test EC key.
CoordinatorMain's USAGE/KNOWN no longer mention raw-payload/raw-response-b64/tls-proof and include --source-id and --request-body-file.
verification: cd coordinator; mvn test  -> BUILD SUCCESS with the updated CoordinatorTest and the other coordinator tests (Canonicalizer, Signer, VsockFraming) still green.
findings:
DONE. cd coordinator; mvn test = BUILD SUCCESS, 18 tests (CoordinatorTest 6 + CanonicalizerTest 6 + SignerTest 1 + VsockFramingTest 5), 0 failures/errors.

Coordinator.java: SOURCE/ENDPOINT constants removed. challengeBody(String requestId, String sourceId) now builds exactly {requestId, sourceId, policyVersion:"v1.0"} (3 keys). enclaveRequest(String requestId, Map challenge, String sourceId, Object requestBody, String evidenceId, String eifDigest) builds the enclave request; rawPayload/rawResponseB64/tlsProof removed. run(String oleaUrl, int enclaveCid, int enclavePort, String sourceId, Object requestBody, Path dowsurePrivateKeyFile, String eifDigest) threads sourceId/requestBody through challengeBody + enclaveRequest. submissionEnvelope + Signer path unchanged.

FINAL enclave-request field set (LinkedHashMap insertion order): requestId, nonce, policyVersion, evidenceId, eifDigest, sourceId, [requestBody only when non-null]. This matches FEAT-002's enclave required set require(requestId,nonce,policyVersion,evidenceId,eifDigest,sourceId) with requestBody optional. No rawPayload/rawResponseB64/tlsProof.

CoordinatorMain.java: dropped --raw-payload-file/--raw-response-b64-file/--tls-proof-file from parsing + KNOWN set; added --source-id (required) and --request-body-file (optional; parsed as JSON into requestBody when present, else null). USAGE updated to: --olea-url, --source-id, [--request-body-file], --dowsure-private-key-file, --eif-digest, [--enclave-cid], [--enclave-port]. Calls new run(...) arity. StandardCharsets/Files imports retained (still used by readJson).

VsockEnclaveClient.java: UNCHANGED — it serializes the request map generically via mapper.writeValueAsBytes(request); no signature or field it reads changed.

CoordinatorTest.java: challengeBodyHasExactShape asserts the {requestId, sourceId, policyVersion} 3-key shape. enclaveRequestPassesTlsProofThroughUntouched replaced by enclaveRequestCarriesSourceIdAndRequestBodyAndDropsLegacyFields (asserts sourceId + requestBody present for POST case, and rawPayload/rawResponseB64/tlsProof absent) plus enclaveRequestOmitsRequestBodyWhenNull. runWiresChallengeEnclaveAndSignsEnvelope and runFailsClosedWhenEnclaveRejects updated to the new run(...) arity (sourceId + null/obj requestBody). Envelope canonical signature verification assertion kept.
